resources.string: Reads the six preview values on screen and taps the Refine / Auto / Retry / Replace buttons for you. All processing stays on the device; nothing is uploaded.

Wos Tools is a personal, offline tool. It reads the screen and taps buttons through the accessibility service. It does not modify the game, does not connect to the internet, and does not collect data. Use it at your own risk; account restrictions are your responsibility.
Priority when the sum is zero
In common builds this attribute adds almost nothing. Enable it anyway?
Only used when the sum is exactly zero. The first non-zero attribute in this order decides keep or re-roll. Selecting a value already used in another slot swaps the two slots.
Extra attributes are appended to the end in fixed order.
Include Infantry Lethality and Lancer Health
Quality upgrades override the sum result and are only checked on the re-roll branch.
The run stops on material exhaustion, manual stop, or the stone limit.
Default is chosen by your Android version. Full screen and compatibility modes hide the floating ball while reading a frame.
Applies to menus, floating control and notifications. Takes effect immediately; default follows the system.
Switch to the game, stay on the pet Refine page (bottom shows Refine / Auto), then tap Start on the floating ball.
Tap self-check failed. Check the accessibility service on this device.
Pause the run before changing settings.
Standby. Switch to the Refine page and tap Start on the floating ball.
Running. Tap Pause or Stop at any time.
Check the game screen, handle the dialog if needed, then tap Resume.
A personal, unofficial project for study and exchange only. Not affiliated with the game. Voluntary support unlocks nothing. You are responsible for any account risk.

Long press a link to copy it.
Value not readable. Paused; check the game screen.
Quality upgrade detected. Paused for manual decision.
Not in the expected page. Paused; return to the Refine page and resume.
Run stopped. Return to the Refine page before starting again.
When the sum is exactly zero
When every enabled value is zero
Main button: tap to start / pause / resume. Long press for status and stop.
Page not recognized. Paused; stay on the Refine page or the preview page (Retry / Replace), then tap Resume.
Preview values did not appear after Refine. Paused; check the capture self-test and the value region.
Only %1$d of 6 rows could be interpreted as a delta or a valid no-change row. Paused; check the per-row diagnosis before adjusting the value region.
Drag the main button up or down; release to snap to the left or right edge.
On start, the app checks the current page: from the Refine page it taps Refine first; from a preview page (Retry / Replace) it judges directly.
Run this while the preview with Retry / Replace buttons is visible. Full result is copied to clipboard and written to log.
Reading current frame… result will be copied to clipboard.
Done. Full diagnostic copied to clipboard; see the floating panel summary.

Capture self-check only verifies that a frame can be captured. It does not read game values. Use the Check values button on the floating ball while the preview with Retry / Replace buttons is visible.

Each row shows row_state, raw text, green/red pixel counts, sign and result. row_state=NO_CHANGE with fg near 0 means the game showed no delta for that row, counted as 0 with no retry. fg with content but an unreadable raw is SUSPECT. Paste the clipboard report when asking for help.
Check values now locates the six delta rows automatically and saves their vertical coordinates. If it fails, paste the clipboard report.

Relative coordinates (0..1). Auto-calibration writes the first row, row spacing and row height; the four left/right edges stay manual. Reset restores the row values from the last calibration and the edges to defaults.
All six rows were readable in single frames, but two frames never agreed within the sampling window. Paused; see the diff below.
Calibration runs once per run and then locks; preview animation frames cannot change the verified row coordinates. If values become unreadable, it unlocks and recalibrates on the next preview frame.
Page did not settle after the action. Paused; check whether the confirm dialog was dismissed.
When the six values cannot be read, the whole capture is retried this many times before pausing. Default 3. Each retry waits for the animation to settle and re-locates the row bands.
Open pet Refine settings and its floating control.
When enabled, the floating ball panel shows Check values and the per-line diagnostics. For troubleshooting value recognition only.
Run auto-calibration once before taking manual control.
Manual mode keeps your values. Check values only reports diagnostics and will not overwrite them.
